opponents.priorSource: synthetic population prior; no private opponent profile

assumptions: Synthetic likelihoods with a nonzero contamination floor; not measured human or solver ranges.
Uniform dealt-card prior; position, depth and shrunk public observations condition action likelihoods.
Range/nut advantages compare public-line model strength and strong-tail proxies, not solved strategy ranges.
Equity is a joint compatible-range showdown share including ties; excludes rake, side-pot eligibility and future betting EV.
Fold equity assumes a half-pot probe and independent fold responses; correlated multiway responses are not modeled.
